## v1.2
- Add a daily alarm (Right button): on/off + time picker, fires every day at the set time
- Alarm flashes the screen with a melody; any key stops it and it stays armed for next day
- Small dot in the top-left corner shows when the alarm is armed
- Add screen brightness control (Up/Down); Down at the lowest level turns on a dim red nightlight
- 12/24-hour format now follows the system locale (removed the manual Up-key toggle); alarm shows AM/PM to match
- Remember the alarm and brightness across restarts
